3000: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-3000-x-tray-insulated-food-tray
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/food-service/correctional-food-trays/x-tray/
Spec sheet: 3000
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray – 3000
Current H1: Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray - 3000
Subtitle: Seamless One-Piece Insulated Meal Tray with Tongue and Groove Compartments That Seal with the Lid
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 3000C, 3000DG, 3000TC, 3000O
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray is a seamless, one-piece meal tray for prisons, jails, and other correctional facilities. It has five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments, and its tongue and groove design seals the entire perimeter and every compartment when the X-Tray lid is on.
The tray is molded from high impact “no break” polypropylene made with FDA-approved material and weighs 1¾ lbs. A raised utensil slot makes delivery easier. The X-Tray fits the Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., Chuckwagon Max, and Tray Master delivery carts.
Material: One-piece, seamless high impact “no break” polypropylene
Compartments: Five insulated food compartments and two condiment compartments for bulk condiments
Seal: Tongue and groove design seals the entire perimeter and all individual compartments
Utensil Slot: Raised utensil slot for delivery
Dimensions: 14¼”L×9½”W×2¼”H; the feeding surface is 1” deep on its own and 2” with a lid
Weight: 1¾ lbs per tray
Stacking: Stacks with or without lids
Cart Capacity: 108 X-Trays (72 with lids) in the Chuckwagon, 64 (40 with lids) in the Chuckwagon Jr., or 108 in the Tray Master
Food Safety: Made with FDA-approved material
Care: Do not use bleach on the trays
Colors: Brown, Dark Gray, Terracotta, or Orange (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 10
Warranty: 5-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
3000C – Brown: X-Tray
3000DG – Dark Gray: X-Tray
3000TC – Terracotta: X-Tray
3000O – Orange: X-Tray
Lids: Matching X-Tray lids (3000L) sold separately
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The X-Tray suits facilities that want a light tray with sealed compartments for meal delivery.
Typical applications include:
Inmate meal service in prisons, jails, and detention centers
Central kitchens that deliver meals to housing units
Juvenile detention and other secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection for more food trays, delivery carts, and food service supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Food Service
Cortech food service products are made for high-volume meal service in correctional facilities, where trays, carts, and dispensers are used and washed every day. Cortech trays and delivery carts are sized to work together.
Cortech food service includes:
Insulated Food Trays: The Rock, Rock 2.0, Rock with Cor-Flex, and X-Tray, with matching lids
Tray Delivery Carts: The insulated Chuckwagon, Chuckwagon Jr., and Chuckwagon Max, and the non-insulated Tray Master
Beverage Service: The BevMax insulated beverage dispenser
Tray Drying: Aluminum meal tray drying racks
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (54 characters): Cortech X-Tray Insulated Food Tray - 3000 at Anchortex
Meta description (150 characters): Shop the Cortech X-Tray. A seamless one-piece insulated meal tray with tongue and groove compartments that seal with the lid, at just 1¾ lbs per tray.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Food Service" is a new section for the food service pages (trays, lids, delivery carts, BevMax, and drying racks). It is the same on each of these pages.
Patent and comparison claims: your current page says "patent pending," "process patented," and "the lightest insulated food tray in the industry." The Cortech spec sheet does not say these, so I left them out.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 5-year factory warranty, so I added it.
Variant names: your variants say "Chocolate Brown," "Dark Grey," and "Terra Cotta." The Cortech spec sheet says "Brown," "Dark Gray," and "Terracotta." Would you like them renamed, for example "3000C - Brown"?
Weight: your variants are set to 24 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 1.75 lbs per tray, so a case of 10 is about 17.5 lbs. I left the variant weight for you to decide.
Case pricing: Cortech sells the trays in cases of 10. Your current pages do not say whether the price is per tray or per case. I wrote "Sold in cases of 10." Is your price per case?
Bleach: the Cortech spec sheet says "Do not use bleach on food trays," so I added it as a Care bullet.
Collection link: I linked the Prison and Detention Kitchen and Food Service Equipment collection, which this product is already in.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has four more photos of the X-Tray in gray, orange, and terracotta. Would you like me to add them?
